# Mode reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs from data/rulesets/*.ron and web/src/rules/catalog.ts. Do not edit by hand: change the
     data and run `node tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs` (CI fails while this file is stale). -->

Every built-in rule set of this build: its mode, teams, match length, the mode's settings,
mutators and arsenal. How each mode plays is in the
[player manual](../player-manual.md#game-modes); hosts pick rule sets by id (the file name
without `.ron`) with `--ruleset <id>` or in a playlist, see the
[hosting guide](../hosting-guide.md#playlists). A server's own rule set file or `LR` code can
change every number here.

## Built-in rule sets

| Rule set (id) | Mode | Teams | Match length | Respawn | Mutators | How to win |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Paint the Void** (`paint_the_void`) | [Paint the Void](#paint-the-void) | 2 | 5 min | 3 s | – | most painted surface when the timer ends (equal: draw) |
| **Team Brawl** (`team_brawl`) | [Team Brawl](#team-brawl) | 2 | 10 min | 3 s | – | first to the kill target (15 to 50, from the player count), else most kills on time (equal: draw) |
| **The Squeeze** (`squeeze`) | [The Squeeze](#the-squeeze) | free-for-all | 15 min | none (one life) | – | last ship flying (ships lost in the same tick: draw) |
| **Heist** (`heist`) | [Heist](#heist) | 2 | 12 min | 3 s | – | first to 3 deliveries, else most deliveries on time (equal: draw) |
| **Hot Reactor** (`hot_reactor`) | [Hot Reactor](#hot-reactor) | free-for-all | 15 min | 3 s | – | last pilot with lives (3 each), else most lives on time |
| **Last Color Standing** (`last_color_standing`) | [Last Color Standing](#last-color-standing) | free-for-all | 15 min | 3 s | – | last pilot with colour, else most colour on time |
| **Instagib Brawl** (`instagib_brawl`) | [Team Brawl](#team-brawl) | 2 | 10 min | 3 s | Instagib | first to the kill target (15 to 50, from the player count), else most kills on time (equal: draw) |
| **Duel** (`duel`) | [Team Brawl](#team-brawl) | free-for-all | 5 min | 3 s | – | first to 10 kills, else most kills on time (equal: draw) |
| **Sandbox - all weapons** (`sandbox_all_weapons`) | [Paint the Void](#paint-the-void) | 2 | 5 min | 3 s | – | most painted surface when the timer ends (equal: draw) |

Which of them a server plays, in which order and for how many players is its playlist
([hosting guide](../hosting-guide.md#lobby-match-end-and-rotation)).

## Paint the Void

Teams paint the level's surfaces in their colour with the Paint Thrower; craters erase paint. Kills don't score.

- **Teams the mode allows:** 2, 3, 4 teams.
- **Built-in rule sets:** Paint the Void (`paint_the_void`), Sandbox - all weapons (`sandbox_all_weapons`).

| Setting | Paint the Void | Sandbox - all weapons | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `teams` | 2 | 2 | Teams (0 = every pilot for themselves) |
| `match_secs` | 5 min | 5 min | Match length (the timer) |
| `respawn_secs` | 3 | 3 | Wait after being destroyed (s) |

## Team Brawl

Team deathmatch with respawns, or every pilot for themselves with 0 teams (the duel). A kill scores 1; a suicide or team kill costs the side points.

- **Teams the mode allows:** free-for-all or 2, 3, 4 teams.
- **Built-in rule sets:** Team Brawl (`team_brawl`), Instagib Brawl (`instagib_brawl`), Duel (`duel`).

| Setting | Team Brawl | Instagib Brawl | Duel | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `teams` | 2 | 2 | free-for-all | Teams (0 = every pilot for themselves) |
| `match_secs` | 10 min | 10 min | 5 min | Match length (the timer) |
| `respawn_secs` | 3 | 3 | 3 | Wait after being destroyed (s) |
| `kill_target` | scaled | scaled | 10 | Kills to win (0 = max(15, 5 × players / teams), at most 50) |
| `team_kill_penalty` | 1 | 1 | 1 | Points a suicide or a team kill costs the side |

## The Squeeze

Every pilot for themselves with one life. Walls grow inward from the level's edge in phases (a warning, then the close) and crush ships caught in them; closing walls shed scrap.

- **Teams the mode allows:** free-for-all.
- **Built-in rule sets:** The Squeeze (`squeeze`).

| Setting | The Squeeze | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `teams` | free-for-all | Teams (0 = every pilot for themselves) |
| `match_secs` | 15 min | Match length (the timer) |
| `respawn_secs` | no respawn | Wait after being destroyed (s) |
| `first_phase_secs` | 60 | First wall warning after the start (s) |
| `phases` | 5 | Wall phases |
| `warn_secs` | 20 | Warning before each close (s) |
| `close_secs` | 30 | Each close takes (s) |
| `crush_per_sec` | 25 | Crushing damage while touching a moving wall (hull/s, ignores shields) |
| `scrap_per_100u2` | 3 | Scrap debris pieces per 100 u² of closed opening |

## Heist

Dig the core out of its vein at the bottom of the level and carry it to your extraction zone. The carrier is slower and can't boost; a dropped core returns to the vein. Kills don't score.

- **Teams the mode allows:** free-for-all or 2 teams.
- **Built-in rule sets:** Heist (`heist`).

| Setting | Heist | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `teams` | 2 | Teams (0 = every pilot for themselves) |
| `match_secs` | 12 min | Match length (the timer) |
| `respawn_secs` | 3 | Wait after being destroyed (s) |
| `deliveries_to_win` | 3 | Deliveries to win |
| `carrier_speed_percent` | 75% | Carrier's top speed (no boost) |
| `drop_return_secs` | 20 | A dropped core returns to the vein after (s) |
| `core_respawn_secs` | 15 | A delivered core is back in the vein after (s) |
| `collapse_secs` | 30 | The mine sheds its ceiling for (s) once the core is free |

## Hot Reactor

A reactor sits on one pilot and passes to whoever hits or rams them. Its fuse runs faster the more ships are near; whoever holds it at detonation loses a life.

- **Teams the mode allows:** free-for-all.
- **Built-in rule sets:** Hot Reactor (`hot_reactor`).

| Setting | Hot Reactor | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `teams` | free-for-all | Teams (0 = every pilot for themselves) |
| `match_secs` | 15 min | Match length (the timer) |
| `respawn_secs` | 3 | Wait after being destroyed (s) |
| `lives` | 3 | Lives (lost only to a detonation in your hands) |
| `fuse_secs` | 20 | Fuse at normal speed (s) |
| `fuse_radius` | 15 | Ships within this distance of the holder speed the fuse up (u) |
| `fuse_speed_per_ship` | +0.5x | Extra fuse speed per ship near the holder |
| `blast_radius` | 10 | Detonation blast radius (u) |
| `blast_damage` | 60 | Detonation blast damage at the centre |
| `pass_immunity_secs` | 1 | A new holder can't lose the reactor for (s) |
| `next_reactor_secs` | 3 | Next reactor appears after (s) |

## Last Color Standing

A black-and-white level; every pilot has a colour meter that each death drains. Out of colour, out of the match. A late-match stalemate drain makes sure it ends.

- **Teams the mode allows:** free-for-all.
- **Built-in rule sets:** Last Color Standing (`last_color_standing`).

| Setting | Last Color Standing | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `teams` | free-for-all | Teams (0 = every pilot for themselves) |
| `match_secs` | 15 min | Match length (the timer) |
| `respawn_secs` | 3 | Wait after being destroyed (s) |
| `colour` | 100 | Colour at the start |
| `drain_per_kill` | 34 | Colour each death drains |
| `stalemate_secs` | 8 min | Stalemate drain starts after |
| `stalemate_drain_secs` | 2 | Stalemate: 1 colour lost every (s) |

## Mutators

Mutators combine with any mode; a rule set lists them in `mutators`.

| Mutator | What it changes | Built-in rule sets with it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Instagib** | Railspike only, fired for free; any direct enemy hit kills, shields or not. No secondaries, gadgets or pickups (Paint the Void keeps its Paint Thrower). Hull and energy are hidden, boost stays; respawns are instant. | `instagib_brawl` |

## Arsenal per rule set

What you start with and what spawns at the level's pickup points. Weapon numbers are in the
[weapon reference](weapons.md), gadgets in the [gadget reference](gadgets.md).

| Rule set | Start with | Pickups | Friendly fire | Ship types |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Paint the Void** | Scrap Laser, Paint Thrower, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Team Brawl** | Scrap Laser, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **The Squeeze** | Scrap Laser, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Heist** | Scrap Laser, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Hot Reactor** | Scrap Laser, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | off | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Last Color Standing** | Scrap Laser, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | off | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Instagib Brawl** | Railspike | none | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Duel** | Scrap Laser, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 25 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |
| **Sandbox - all weapons** | Scrap Laser, Paint Thrower, 3 Bolt Rockets, Shield | 28 of 28 weapons; Scrap Laser upgrades; Shield, Cloak, Decoy; scrap piles | 50% | Skitter, Tinker, Hauler, Tug |

Friendly fire only matters in team modes (in free-for-all every other ship is an enemy).
